asked.item: Sending 14 quick reply chips in one message

verdict.reason: The pages give a limit of 13 quick-reply chips per message on both Facebook and Instagram, so 14 is over it.

steps.text: Quick-reply chips are limited to 13 per message on Facebook.
Quick-reply chips are also limited to 13 per message on Instagram, so a message with 14 chips is over the limit.
